name: odyssey-ai
description: Claude Code plugins from Odyssey AI.

plugins.name: odyssey
plugins.description: Built to get each change right the first time: planned work stays inside the files its plan names, and the repo's gate runs before each commit Claude makes. At a context mark it saves memory, writes the handoff and, with its launcher, starts the next session by itself. Adds a CodeRabbit review loop and guard hooks; its cost is benchmarked against plain Claude Code.
